species.name: Snipe
mustRead: extremely long straight dagger bill
eye set high and far back on the head
bold cream stripes running along the back

species.name: Roadrunner
mustRead: long trailing tail often cocked upward
shaggy black crest on the head
long strong bare legs and heavy pointed bill

species.name: Gull
mustRead: heavy hooked-tipped bill
clean white body with a grey mantle and black wingtips
long wings crossing beyond the tail
species.note: Generic name read as a representative herring-gull type.

species.name: Plover
mustRead: large round head with a very short stubby bill
big dark eye
compact upright body on medium legs
species.note: Distinguished from a sandpiper by the short pigeon-like bill and the big-headed, big-eyed look.

species.name: Sandpiper
mustRead: slim straightish probing bill about head length
horizontal crouched body
long thin wading legs

species.name: Pigeon
mustRead: small round head on a deep barrel chest
short red legs
broad fan tail and slender bill with a white cere

species.name: Snowy Owl
mustRead: big smooth round head with no ear tufts
brilliant yellow forward-facing eyes in a white face
heavily feathered feet
species.note: Taller than wide when perched upright; the body is a rounded column, not a horizontal hawk shape.

species.name: Swan
mustRead: very long S-curved neck
large white body floating high on the water
broad flat bill with a coloured base

species.name: Tern
mustRead: deeply forked tail streamers
long narrow pointed wings
slim dagger bill and a black cap over the crown

species.name: Auk
mustRead: upright penguin-like stance with black back and white front
small stubby wings held tight to the body
legs set far back at the rear of the body
species.note: Generic name read as a representative razorbill-type auk. Stands vertically, so it is taller than long.

species.name: Puffin
mustRead: huge triangular laterally flattened bill striped orange and blue-grey
big white face patch on a black cap
bright orange webbed feet

species.name: Guillemot
mustRead: long slender pointed dagger bill
upright chocolate-brown-and-white body
narrow head running smoothly into the neck

species.name: Eider Duck
mustRead: long wedge-shaped bill running in a straight line into the forehead
bulky heavy-bodied duck sitting low in the water
black-and-white blocks with a pale green nape
species.note: The unbroken sloping wedge from bill tip to crown is the key read; a normal duck's stepped forehead is wrong.

species.name: Penguin
mustRead: fully upright standing posture on short rear-set feet
stiff flipper wings held flat at the sides
black back and white belly countershading

species.name: Albatross
mustRead: immensely long narrow stiff-held wings
heavy hooked bill with tube nostrils on the sides
short tail behind a bulky body
species.note: Wings are narrow and plank-straight, not broad and fingered like a raptor's.

species.name: Petrel
mustRead: tubular nostrils riding on top of the bill
narrow angled swept-back wings
compact gull-like body

species.name: Skua
mustRead: heavy hooked pirate bill
white flash at the base of the primaries
barrel-chested bulky gull build

species.name: Condor
mustRead: bare wrinkled unfeathered head
huge plank-broad wings with splayed fingered primaries
white ruff of feathers at the neck base

species.name: Swift
mustRead: scythe-shaped crescent wings swept far back
tiny bill with an enormous gape
cigar body with almost no visible legs
species.note: Often drawn as a swallow; the swift has stiffer sickle wings, a much shorter notched tail, and no long streamers.

species.name: Loon
mustRead: straight dagger bill held level
checkerboard black-and-white back
long body riding low in the water
species.note: Legs are set at the extreme rear - it cannot stand upright like a duck and should not be drawn walking.

species.name: Grebe
mustRead: thin sharply pointed bill
puffy rounded rear with no visible tail
lobed rather than webbed toes

species.name: Cormorant
mustRead: hook-tipped bill on a long snaky neck
wings held open to dry in a heraldic pose
low-slung body with a stiff wedge tail

species.name: Pelican
mustRead: enormous bill with a stretchy throat pouch slung beneath
heavy body on very short legs
long neck kinked back onto the shoulders

species.name: Osprey
mustRead: white underside with a dark mask stripe through the eye
crooked M-shaped gull-like wings
hooked bill and outsized barbed talons
